task_completion.description: Log into the SEB Server Administration Interface at http://localhost:8080 using super-admin credentials.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the SEB Server dashboard or administration panel after entering 'super-admin' and 'admin'.

task_completion.description: Initiate the creation of a new SEB exam configuration.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A 'New Configuration' or 'Add Configuration' form is visible on the screen.

task_completion.description: Set the configuration name to 'Biology Final - Moodle AutoQuit'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The text 'Biology Final - Moodle AutoQuit' is typed into the Name or Title field of the configuration form.
The specific URL 'https://lms.university.edu/mod/quiz/review.php' is entered into the 'Quit URL' field.

task_completion.description: Disable the 'Confirm Quit' prompt so the browser closes immediately.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The checkbox for 'Confirm Quit' or 'Show Quit Confirmation' is unchecked/disabled.
The agent clicks a 'Save' or 'Create' button, and a success message or the updated list of configurations is displayed.

integrity.description: The agent used the web interface rather than executing database commands or scripts via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse movements and typing within the browser window, not a terminal/shell.

integrity.description: The agent navigated the SEB Server UI menus to find the settings.
integrity.visual_evidence: The trajectory shows the agent clicking through the SEB Server navigation tabs (e.g., Configurations) to reach the target form.

integrity.description: The agent manually entered the required strings rather than using automated script injection.
integrity.visual_evidence: The text appears in the input fields sequentially or via standard copy-paste from the prompt, within the context of the GUI.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The configuration must be named 'Biology Final - Moodle AutoQuit'. The Quit URL must be exactly 'https://lms.university.edu/mod/quiz/review.php'. The 'Confirm Quit' setting must be explicitly disabled (unchecked) to ensure the browser closes immediately without a prompt.
